# Pixel Anagram Checker

A simple offline browser app that checks whether two texts are anagrams, ignoring spaces and letter case. It also keeps a history of the last 5 checks.

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Features

- Two labeled text inputs.
- Check button (also triggered by Enter key in either input).
- Result message with visual pass/fail styling.
- History of the last 5 checks, newest first.
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states.
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide.

## Notes

- Only spaces are ignored (not punctuation or digits).
- Empty inputs are handled gracefully (no history entry added).
- All code is offline; no external resources.
